overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete document templates, such as PDF document layouts.
intro: Document templates are the settings records behind generated documents, each with a type such as `PDF_DOCUMENT`. You can list, create, read, update and delete them. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **`name` and `document_template_type` are required on a create.** For example `"document_template_type": "PDF_DOCUMENT"`.
**A read reports the type in `type`.** It also says whether the template is a system, custom, default or edited one.
**Listings page by cursor.** Pass `limit` for the page size, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is true.
**A delete returns `204` with no body.** Reading the document template afterwards returns `404`.

endpoints.title: List document templates
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of document templates under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the document templates on the instance. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of document templates, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create a document template
endpoints.summary: Creates a document template and returns it under `document_template`.
endpoints.description: Send the new document template under `document_template`. `name` and `document_template_type`, such as `PDF_DOCUMENT`, are required. A read reports the type in `type`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a document template
endpoints.summary: Returns one document template by its `id`, under `document_template`.
endpoints.description: Reads the document template with this `dt_` `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: document_template_id
parameters.description: The document template's `dt_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a document template
endpoints.summary: Deletes a document template. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the document template with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: document_template_id
parameters.description: The document template's `dt_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The document template is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Update a document template
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a document template and returns it under `document_template`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `document_template`. You can change its fields or its content.

parameters.name: document_template_id
parameters.description: The document template's `dt_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

created_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

last_updated_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
